report.answer_text:
*The Shape of Water* (2017) is a fantasy romance set in 1962 Baltimore during the Cold War. Elisa, a mute woman who works as a cleaner at a secret government laboratory, discovers that the lab is holding a mysterious amphibious humanoid captive. She starts visiting him in secret, bringing him hard-boiled eggs, playing music, and communicating through sign language. Over time, they fall in love.
When Elisa learns that the officials in charge plan to kill and dissect him, she enlists her friends to help him escape. But getting him out of the lab is only the first hurdle: the ruthless officer who captured him is determined to get him back.
